Meet Tommie Truffles! My name is TOMMIE TRUFFLES! I like sticks. I like stones and I like pine cones. Foster mom says, “Twuffles wanna tweets?” Silly, she talks to me like I’m a baby.  Well, I am quite young, maybe 9-12 months, and I do have a lot to learn. I hope you can help teach me.



Angels Among Pet Rescue located in the Atlanta, Georgia metro area.
You can also email inquiry@angelsrescue.org to ask additional questions.

For Information on a specific dog or for additional information regarding our 501c organization, email inquiry@angelsrescue.org

To apply to Adopt, www.angelsrescue.org/adopt
